outcome: Maternal risk factors associated with amniotic fluid disorders
Maternal and fetal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by amniotic fluid disorders
Mode of delivery in pregnancies complicated by amniotic fluid disorders
finding: Diabetes mellitus and gestational diabetes are the most important maternal risk factors that can cause amniotic fluid disorders.
mod_finding: Oligohydramnios was associated with a higher rate of vaginal deliveries, while polyhydramnios was associated with a higher rate of cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Infants born to mothers with oligohydramnios had lower birth weights, while infants born to mothers with polyhydramnios had higher birth weights
